newsitem.title: USA: Wandel & Goltermann sees Q2 EPS at $0.10-$0.15.
newsitem.headline: Wandel & Goltermann sees Q2 EPS at $0.10-$0.15.

text.p: Wandel & Goltermann Technologies Inc said Wednesday its earnings per share for its fiscal second quarter ended March 31 is expected to range from $0.10 to $0.15, compared to $0.23 a year ago.

It said that based on a preliminary analysis of its results for the latest quarter, its revenues will be between $14.5 million and $15.0 million, compared with $14.496 million it reported for the comparable quarter of fiscal year 1996.

Gerry Chastelet, president and chief executive, said, "The the company's second quarter results were directly affected by slowdowns in capital expenditures by some of our larger customers and longer than expected time it is taking for the U.S. distribution channels to address our new markets."
He added that share earnings were also affected by foreign currency losses resulting from the strengthening of the U.S. dollr against the German mark during the quarrter, he added.
The company said it plans to announce actual results for the quarter on April 28.
Wandel & Golterman provides network analysis solutions for network operators, service providers and laboratories around the world.
